TopologyOperationWithMixedCLusterTest::t.description: Real-binary rolling upgrade (upgrade_matrix_from_last_release_version = release:2026.1 -> version under test) of a 6-node, 3-rack cluster. After upgrading node1/node2 (inserting+validating data after each), bootstraps a new node with the target version in node1's rack, then stops and removenodes the still-old node3 from upgraded node1, upgrades the remaining nodes and runs upgradesstables + sstable dump check. Guards bootstrap/removenode in a mixed-version cluster (originated from scylladb/scylladb#20299 investigation).

origin.summary: Test(upgrade): Run schema topology change in mixed upgraded cluster; adds tests for scylladb/scylladb#20299 (bootstrap old/new-version node, removenode old node, raft snapshot transfer).

commits.b969af9c094e953b39d991a3969f3e32e1f99d1b: Removed bootstrap of a base-version node in mixed cluster (unsupported per scylladb/scylladb#23837); fixes #23837.

TopologyOperationWithMixedCLusterTest::t.relevance: Live: rolling upgrades with topology ops (bootstrap, removenode) in a mixed-version cluster are supported operations; bootstrap of old-version node is explicitly unsupported and was removed from the test (scylladb/scylladb#23837). Runs only in dtest-release/dtest-release-with-raft (dtest_full), 37 runs, 100% pass, ~127s.

duplicates.note: Simulated upgrade via test feature flags (same binary) + removenode of non-upgraded node; no real old binary, no bootstrap of new-version node.
Covers the (unsupported) old-node-join side only, simulated.

TopologyOperationWithMixedCLusterTest::t.reason: Unique real-binary mixed-version bootstrap+removenode coverage (scylla test.py only simulates upgrades via feature flags). Note: no data validation after node7 bootstrap / node3 removenode (last validate_data is before add_new_node, topology_operation_during_upgrade_test.py:71); only upgrade_and_verify_sstable sstable dump + schema agreement checks follow, so data loss from the topology ops would go unnoticed.

issues.text: no data validation after node7 bootstrap / node3 removenode; only op success, schema agreement and sstable dump checked

TopologyOperationWithMixedCLusterTest::t.description: Rolling upgrade 2026.1 -> version under test on 6 nodes/3 racks (consistent-topology-changes only). After upgrading node1/node2, stops old-version node3, creates new keyspace/table (group0 schema changes), triggers a group0 raft snapshot on the topology coordinator via REST /raft/trigger_snapshot and waits for snapshot_id change, then restarts node3 (old version) so it receives a snapshot from a newer node. Asserts node3 log has no 'ERROR.*database - regular column' (the 'regular column id N >= N' internal error from scylladb/scylladb#20299, when new-version system table schemas with extra columns are applied on an old node), then upgrades the rest and validates data.

origin.summary: Test(upgrade): Run schema topology change in mixed upgraded cluster; reproducer for scylladb/scylladb#20299 (snapshot transfer new->old fails with 'regular column id 5 >= 5').

TopologyOperationWithMixedCLusterTest::t.relevance: Live: fix for #20299 (31ea74b96e 'db: system_keyspace: change version of topology_requests schema') relies on developers manually bumping system table schema versions when adding columns, so the bug class can recur on each release boundary. Error messages still in schema/schema.cc:186 and :2081; REST /raft/trigger_snapshot still exists (raft/server.cc:679). Runs in next gating (tablets + consistent-topology), 32 runs, 100% pass, ~138s.
